question: What is the total prize money announced for the 2025 ICC Champions Trophy?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​**__**$6.9 million**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Champions Trophy 2025 starts on February 19**: Pakistan faces New Zealand in the opener.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India to play in Dubai**: Due to the hybrid model, India's matches and the final (if India qualifies) will be held in Dubai.
 
• **Prize money announced**:
 
 
• **Winners**: $2.24 million (~₹20.8 crore)
 
• **Runners-up**: $1.12 million (~₹10.4 crore)
 
• **Losing semi-finalists**: $560,000 (~₹5.2 crore) each
 
 
 
• **Total prize pool**: $6.9 million, a 53% increase from 2017.
 
• **Guaranteed minimum**: $125,000 for each of the 8 participating teams.
 
• **Positions 5th & 6th**: $350,000 each; **7th & 8th**: $140,000 each.
 
• **Final on March 9, 2025**.
